reason: Free listing I might accept if they really do the work for me, but paying is a no until I see real people using it. I've paid for promo platforms before that brought nobody.
objection: An app with no audience yet, from people I don't know. Everyone promises crowds and then nobody turns up at my door.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app pass 2,000 monthly users in my city and a few bars nearby telling me it actually filled their nights.
